_comment: Numeric breakpoints for compute_probability(). Calibrated as a starting point against CLAUDE.md dataset facts (~14K imaging events, 32.6% software-design recalls). Draft v1 — needs review against real event-count distributions per failure mode.

event_count_breakpoints._comment: Base probability level from count of directly matching FDA adverse events (state.matching_events). Smallest breakpoint the count is <= determines the level.

recall_override._comment: A confirmed recall for the same failure mode means the issue is at least 'occasional' even with few individual event reports.

growth_rate_overrides._comment: 30-day cluster growth rate from the Similarity Module. A fast-growing cluster raises probability regardless of raw event count, since it signals an emerging pattern not yet fully reported.

cluster_size_overrides._comment: Large existing cluster size is independent evidence of higher occurrence rate.
